name: SQLite Judgment Queue Phase 1 Closeout
description: Finish the SQLite-backed OLTP judgment queue rollout by moving residual cursor state into per-job SQLite, adding visibility-aware import and cleanup behavior, and covering the remaining crash and contention gaps.

userStories.title: Finalize SQLite job_scan_state as the active cursor source
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want each SQLite-backed job to persist its full scan cursor and visibility state locally so active queue scanning no longer depends on DuckDB cursor fields.
acceptanceCriteria: `job_scan_state` stores the active cursor fields together with `scan_epoch` and `last_project_refresh_ack_seq` for SQLite-backed jobs.
The SQLite scan-state service reads and writes cursor, exhaustion, scan epoch, and visibility watermark values without losing existing cursor data.
SQLite-backed prompt top-up uses `job_scan_state` as its cursor source of truth and does not require `app.judgment_job` cursor fields during scanning.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Make SQLite outbox import replay-safe after partial success
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the SQLite outbox importer to recover cleanly when DuckDB commit succeeds before SQLite export acknowledgement so replay never duplicates judgments or strands claimed rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running the importer after DuckDB insert success but before SQLite ack does not create duplicate `app.judgment` rows for the same natural key.
Claimed outbox rows can be completed idempotently after replay so partially successful batches do not remain stuck in claimed state.
Importer failure before DuckDB commit still leaves affected outbox rows retryable on the next import attempt.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Acknowledge mart visibility watermarks back to SQLite
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want each job to record how far DuckDB and mart refreshes have become visible so queue wrap and cleanup decisions can wait for durable read visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: After imported judgments become visible to the mart refresh path, SQLite records a per-job `last_project_refresh_ack_seq` watermark.
The stored visibility watermark only moves forward and is tied to imported `outbox_seq` values for the affected job.
Jobs without completed visibility acknowledgement keep their previous watermark instead of advancing optimistically.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Gate cursor wrap on visibility acknowledgement
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want exhausted SQLite scans to wrap only after prior exports are visible in DuckDB so the top-up path cannot re-enqueue already judged prompt pairs.
acceptanceCriteria: A SQLite-backed job wraps its scan cursor to the start only when the visibility watermark covers the exported work from the completed pass.
`scan_epoch` increments exactly once when a full scan pass legitimately wraps back to the start.
Jobs whose visibility watermark is behind remain exhausted instead of re-enqueueing previously exported prompt pairs.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Prune exported rows only after visibility acknowledgement
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want retention cleanup to remove only rows that are already visible through DuckDB and marts so cleanup cannot break dedupe or force stale re-enqueue.
acceptanceCriteria: Retention cleanup deletes exported `judgment_outbox` rows only when their `outbox_seq` is at or below the job visibility watermark.
Retention cleanup deletes terminal `queue_prompt` rows only after the corresponding exported work is visibility-acked.
Cleanup runs in bounded batches and leaves newer or unacked rows untouched.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Delete drained per-job SQLite databases only after full drain
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want per-job SQLite files removed only after queue work, outbox export, and visibility-gated cleanup are finished so finished jobs leave no residue without risking data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Drained-job cleanup removes or archives the per-job SQLite DB and lease sidecar only when the job has no active queue rows and no pending visibility-gated outbox data.
Active or partially drained SQLite-backed jobs remain on disk and continue to serve retries or cleanup work.
Legacy DuckDB-backed jobs keep their existing cleanup behavior during rollout.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Add duplicate-claim contention coverage for SQLite queues
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a regression test for competing writers so the SQLite claim path proves each prompt pair can only be claimed once under contention.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a test where competing writers race to claim ready rows for the same SQLite-backed job.
The test proves each `(job_id, article_id, prompt_id)` pair is claimed at most once.
The test exercises the lease or transaction behavior used by the production SQLite claim path.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Add crash-replay coverage for SQLite outbox import
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a regression test for importer replay so crashes between DuckDB commit and SQLite acknowledgement cannot silently duplicate or strand judgments.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a test that simulates DuckDB commit succeeding before SQLite export acknowledgement completes.
Re-running the importer in the test does not duplicate `app.judgment` rows and eventually clears the affected outbox work.
The test asserts the replay path preserves the same dedupe guarantees as the normal import path.
bun run lint passes
bun test passes

userStories.title: Add drain-then-delete lifecycle coverage for job cleanup
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a regression test for job cleanup so SQLite job files disappear only after export, visibility acknowledgement, and retention cleanup have fully drained.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a test that covers job completion, visibility acknowledgement, retention cleanup, and final SQLite DB deletion or archival.
The test proves cleanup does not remove the job DB while export or visibility drain is still incomplete.
The test proves the SQLite DB and lease sidecar disappear only after the job is fully drained.
